Return JSON {"people":[{"name":str,"role":str,"change":"appointed|resigned|retired|re-appointed|ceased|redesignated","effective":str|null,"reason":str|null,"bio":[up to 4 short factual bullets: prior roles/companies, education, years of experience]}],"headline":"one sentence, max 20 words"}. If the text has no profile, bio = [].|Sub: Disclosure under Regulation 30 read with Clause 7 of Paragraph A of Part A of Schedule III of the SEBI 
(Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (“SEBI Listing Regulations”) 
We wish to inform you that Mr. Sanjay D’Souza has superannuated from the services of the Bank with effect from 
the close of business hours on October 31, 2026 and has accordingly ceased to be the Group Head – Business Banking, 
Emerging & Micro Enterprises Group and a Senior Management Personnel of the Bank. 
During his association with the Bank for nearly 27 years, Mr. Sanjay D’Souza was one of the key architects of the 
Bank’s SME business, contributing significantly across both Credit and Business. Under his leadership, the Bank 
established a strong leadership position in this space. The Bank would like to place on record its sincere appreciation 
for the dedicated services provided by Mr. Sanjay D’Souza. 
This is for your information and appropriate dissemination. 
Thank you. 
Yours faithfully, 
For HDFC Bank Limited 
Ajay Agarwal

Group Head – Secretarial & Group Oversight
